ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email for the first admin account, created on first boot. You sign in with it and ADMIN_PASSWORD.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the first admin account. Generated; read it here after deploy. Only used on first boot - change it in Paperclip afterwards.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sessions and agent tokens. Generated; changing it signs everyone out.

PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL of this instance, used for sign-in, invite links and agent callbacks. Change it if you add a custom domain.

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection over Railway's private network.

PORT.description: Port Paperclip listens on. Leave as is.

PAPERCLIP_VERSION.description: Paperclip image tag to build from (github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/releases, without the v). Raise it and redeploy to upgrade; migrations run on start.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time running agent jobs get to stop cleanly on redeploy.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Anthropic API key for Claude Code agents. Or set CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN to use a Claude subscription.

CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.description: Optional. Claude subscription token for Claude Code agents, from `claude setup-token` on your machine.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. OpenAI API key for Codex agents (and OpenCode).

PGDATA.description: Data subdirectory - keeps Postgres happy on Railway volumes

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time for Postgres to shut down cleanly on redeploy
